{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Ablation eval: 4 GPU parallel
# Usage: bash run_ablation_eval.sh [20|50]  (default: 20)
set -e

ROLLOUTS=${1:-20}
EVAL_SCRIPT="vla-scripts/evaluate_safelibero.py"
RESULT_DIR="/root/occsafe_vla/eval_results"
CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints"
CKPT_SUFFIX="openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+b8+lr-0.0005+lora-r32+dropout-0.0--image_aug--50000_chkpt"
mkdir -p "$RESULT_DIR"

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe
cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft

EXPS=("ablation_occ_detach_s0" "ablation_random_occ_s0" "ablation_occ_detach_s1" "ablation_random_occ_s1")
GPUS=(0 1 2 3)

# Verify all checkpoints exist before launching
ALL_READY=true
for exp in "${EXPS[@]}"; do
    ckpt="$CKPT_BASE/$exp/$CKPT_SUFFIX"
    if [ ! -d "$ckpt" ]; then
        echo "MISSING: $ckpt"
        ALL_READY=false
    fi
done
if [ "$ALL_READY" = false ]; then
    echo "Some checkpoints not ready. Abort."
    exit 1
fi

PIDS=()
for i in "${!EXPS[@]}"; do
    exp="${EXPS[$i]}"
    gpu="${GPUS[$i]}"
    ckpt="$CKPT_BASE/$exp/$CKPT_SUFFIX"
    out="$RESULT_DIR/${exp}_${ROLLOUTS}r_50000.json"
    log="$RESULT_DIR/${exp}_${ROLLOUTS}r_50000.log"

    echo "Starting $exp on GPU $gpu with $ROLLOUTS rollouts..."
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=$gpu \
        python3 $EVAL_SCRIPT \
        --pretrained_checkpoint "$ckpt" \
        --task_suite_name libero_spatial \
        --num_rollouts $ROLLOUTS \
        --seed 42 \
        --output_path "$out" \
        > "$log" 2>&1 &
    PIDS+=($!)
done

echo "All 4 evals launched (PIDs: ${PIDS[*]}). Waiting..."

FAILED=0
for i in "${!EXPS[@]}"; do
    if ! wait ${PIDS[$i]}; then
        echo "FAILED: ${EXPS[$i]} (PID ${PIDS[$i]})"
        FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    else
        echo "DONE: ${EXPS[$i]}"
    fi
done

echo "=== Complete. $((4-FAILED))/4 succeeded. Results in $RESULT_DIR/ ==="
